resources.string: Active background synchronization and real-time command processing
Connected and synchronizing with management server
Authorized diagnostic recording requested by administrator

Reads text visible on the screen (including text inside apps and may include sensitive content such as password fields) and reports it to the management server configured for this device. This service is intended for devices you own or administer, with the informed consent of the device user. Enable only if you understand that on-screen text is collected and transmitted.
